column1: # db_pool_sizing.tsv — the connection-pool arithmetic, shared between
# rust/crates/sky/src/db_pool_sizing.rs (which sizes clusters before any Go runs).
# Both languages assert they reproduce it, so regenerating without following
# the change on the other side turns that side red.
# The second column is the raw <PREFIX>_DB_MAX_OPEN_CONNS the process will
# read — Go-quoted, or a bare `-` when the knob is unset. It is an AXIS of
# this table, not a footnote: the app's pool follows that knob, three of the
# four terms already did, and a table over `cpus` alone could not see the
# consumers <tab> comma-separated names, in demand order
